data.name: Astral Traveler
data.detailed_description:
Blaze your way through 47 challenging tracks as you dodge obstacles at breakneck speeds, shooting down the enemy raiders blocking your path and phasing through pulsars for an extra burst of speed. Your astral core is fading and a moment’s distraction will spell your doom, but the warp gate to the next track is just up ahead, if your skills are tight enough to reach it.

  • Lightning fast arcade racing action
  • Master precise platforming and snake through various obstacles
  • Shoot down armies of enemy raiders
  • Phase through energy barriers and speed boost through pulsars
  • Conquer 47 sectors across 5 different nebulas
  • Dominate your friends on the leaderboards
  • Affordable price tag.
